meta.name: dragonfruit
meta.description: The single source of visual truth (T-08). Primitive -> semantic -> component. Edit this file and run scripts/gen-tokens.py; never hand-edit the generated Theme.qml or design_tokens.rs.

light.provenance: REFERENCE.md Dock plate: light neutral fit alpha 0.253 / tint 0.604; rim peak 0.397 on mid-grey; blur sigma 3.86pt first fit

dark.provenance: REFERENCE.md Dock plate: dark neutral fit alpha 0.149 / tint 0.207; blur and rim reuse the light fit because the dark rim was not separately fitted

light.provenance: REFERENCE.md menu-bar veil: alpha 0.451 at y=5pt, then 0.439/0.408/0.357/0.243/0.059/0.008 to y=90pt; white background shows no visible veil; the veil is not a blur

dark.provenance: No standalone dark veil was measured in the first campaign; the coverage dark captures over neutral black/mid/white give a top alpha of ~0.125 over mid-grey and zero over white. Dragonfruit uses the measured light depth shape at a 0.48 peak, scaled by 0.286 of the light luminance response to match the mid-grey capture.

light.provenance: REFERENCE.md System Settings light File anchors at 0/0.5255/1 -> alpha 0.732/0.552/0.415, tint 0.953/0.993/0.997; File blur sigma ~10pt

dark.provenance: The published dark File fit is contaminated by a light crop (REFERENCE.md); the attached-menu baseline is anchored to the valid dark mid/black context/status family (alpha 0.66 / tint 0.26), mixed 25% toward a deeper adapted baseline. The white row stays open for a controlled recapture.

light.provenance: REFERENCE.md common light status/context menus cluster near alpha 0.55 and near-white tint; detached menus are rounded cards

dark.provenance: REFERENCE.md dark Desktop/Wi-Fi/Bluetooth/Battery fits near alpha 0.66 / tint 0.26 with substantial residuals; this is the detached-menu baseline

light.provenance: REFERENCE.md light status menus join the common context-menu cluster; 8pt blur is a local adaptation

dark.provenance: REFERENCE.md dark Wi-Fi/Bluetooth/Battery status fits near alpha 0.66 / tint 0.26; 8pt blur is a local adaptation

light.provenance: No direct tooltip optical fit; the reference tooltip is 33pt high and 8pt above the Dock plate. Named popup baseline 0.72/0.92

dark.provenance: No dark tooltip fit; named popup baseline 0.76/0.24

light.provenance: REFERENCE.md later controlled Control Center light outer fit alpha 0.265 / tint 0.373; REPORT.md 3.5/Appendix A give the 8 pt blur, 0.30 rim and 6 pt/24 pt capsule-end lens

dark.provenance: REFERENCE.md later controlled Control Center dark outer fit alpha 0.489 / tint 0.677; blur/rim/lens reuse the light capsule fit because the dark end caustic was not separately measured

light.provenance: REFERENCE.md Wi-Fi module light fit 0.391/0.317 is an observed effective stacked response. The compositor flat-band output is opaque, so this preset is the module's final composite in its own region; it is not layered a second time over the outer plate

dark.provenance: No reliable dark module decomposition; adapted effective 0.65/0.44 so the opaque module reads darker than the 0.489/0.677 dark outer plate

light.provenance: The expanded list is unmeasured in light; adapted readable near-opaque light plate (0.94/0.96) so dark list text stays legible

dark.provenance: REFERENCE.md Bluetooth expanded list is dark (~0.13 luma) with no reliable alpha decomposition; near-opaque 0.96/0.13 keeps the composite within 0.04 luma over white/black
T205: the dark banner is uncovered as an independent fit (underconstrained); adapted readable 0.56/0.30 so it reads lighter than the dark stack and keeps light-on-glass text contrast

light.provenance: REFERENCE.md light notification stack 0.551/0.706; the stack residual is materially larger than the banner's
REFERENCE.md light notification lower panel 0.407/0.852; the residual is materially larger than the banner's

dark.provenance: T205: the dark lower panel is uncovered as an independent fit (underconstrained); adapted readable 0.40/0.30 so it reads below the dark stack on black/mid/white and stays distinct from the dark banner

light.provenance: REFERENCE.md light System Settings sidebar/toolbar 0.986/0.857 and 0.961/0.965; Finder 0.985/0.858 and 0.994/0.922. Named near-opaque 0.975/0.91

dark.provenance: REFERENCE.md dark Finder sidebar/toolbar 0.935/0.218 and 0.900/0.247. Named near-opaque 0.918/0.233

light.provenance: T206 REFERENCE.md light System Settings sidebar 0.986/0.857. The muted sidebar shows a small chroma pickup; the preset stores only a scalar neutral tint, so the chroma component stays an explicit transport gap (ADR 0225).

dark.provenance: T206 Settings Dark is not independently measured; adapted from the measured Finder dark sidebar 0.935/0.218 (REFERENCE.md) because System Settings and Finder share the near-opaque source-list material.

light.provenance: T206 REFERENCE.md light System Settings toolbar 0.961/0.965. Near-opaque, so the scalar tint carries the visible result; no chroma channel is stored.

dark.provenance: T206 Settings Dark is not independently measured; adapted from the measured Finder dark toolbar 0.900/0.247 (REFERENCE.md).

light.provenance: T206 REFERENCE.md light Finder sidebar 0.985/0.858. The muted sidebar shows the measured small chroma pickup; the scalar preset cannot carry it (ADR 0225).
